scaling_rule.place_size_dp: clamp(base * s, lo, 200): phone/tablet43 base 140, lo 120; phone_compact base 120, lo 100 (tap >= 96 dp, centres >= 104 dp apart, 72 dp minimum touch target holds)
scaling_rule.place_position: frame offset + center_dp * s (equivalently center_fraction of the drawn map rect)
scaling_rule.tap_area: circle of 130/140 of the place size, centred

phone.note: 812 x 375 dp frame; 16:9 phones see the centred safe16x9 crop

hud_safe_zone_dp.contents: sound button 72 dp + parental-gate gear 44 dp, 24 dp margins; fixed dp, never scaled

phone.use_when: screen height > 360 dp and width / height >= 1.7

tablet43.note: 1024 x 768 dp frame for 4:3 tablets; same island redrawn with places spread vertically

hud_safe_zone_dp.contents: sound button 72 dp + parental-gate gear 44 dp, 24 dp margins; fixed dp, never scaled

tablet43.use_when: screen height > 360 dp and width / height < 1.7 (4:3 and 16:10 tablets)

phone_compact.note: 640 x 360 dp frame (16:9) for small phones (568x320, 640x360): places at 120 dp nominal, lighthouse pulled inland, shadow + puzzle islets out at sea; v1.1: puzzle islet pulled in to (550,276) and shadow islet to (466,186) so all puzzle art incl. padlock badge stays >= 24 dp from right/bottom edges (20 dp gesture margin + 4 dp)

hud_safe_zone_dp.contents: sound button 72 dp + parental-gate gear 44 dp, 24 dp margins; fixed dp, never scaled

phone_compact.use_when: screen height <= 360 dp (any width); checked at 568x320 (s 0.889: place 106.7 dp, tap 99 dp, min centre distance 109.4 dp; puzzle art margins right 29.1 / bottom 25.8 dp) and 640x360 (s 1: place 120, tap 111.4, distance 123.1; margins right 33.2 / bottom 29.0)

map.layout_selection: height <= 360 dp -> phone_compact; else width/height < 1.7 -> tablet43; else phone
map.note: Spot positions moved to map.layouts.<phone|tablet43> (v1.2). Module pictograms are no longer shown on map places.
